note: Eight Mac tasks, read-only or reversible on scratch files. The same prompt goes to every arm. {S} is the scratch directory. Success is judged by check, never by the agent's own claim.

tasks.prompt: In TextEdit, open the file {S}/scratch.txt, replace all of its text with exactly: mewla bench one. Save it (cmd+s) and tell me when it is saved.
In Finder, in the folder {S}, rename the file rename-me.txt to renamed.txt. Tell me when done.
In Finder, open the folder {S}/many and tell me how many items it holds and the name of the one called largest-*.
In System Settings, find the macOS version shown under General > About and tell me the number.
In Calculator, work out 12 times 34 with its buttons and tell me the number it shows.
In Notes, make a new note (in the folder that is open) whose text is: bench note. Tell me when it is there.

check.manual: a note 'bench note' exists; the Mac Brain verifies it by reading and removes only that note

tasks.prompt: In {ELECTRON_APP}, without changing anything or sending anything, tell me {ELECTRON_QUESTION}.
In Calendar, without changing anything, tell me the title of the first event today after 9:00, or say there is none.
